shots.title: Fix slope version bump staging for the bundled plugin manifest (#524)
shots.notes: Updated slope version bump so it stages both package.json and templates/codex/plugins/slope/.codex-plugin/plugin.json after scripts/version-bump.mjs updates them, with regression coverage.

shots.title: Make roadmap status select active inserted sprints before later planned work (#525)
shots.notes: Made roadmap status resolve the current sprint from explicit active state and earliest non-terminal roadmap work, including decimal sprint ids, so inserted release sprints do not get skipped.

shots.title: Bump package and bundled plugin manifest to 1.58.1
shots.notes: Ran scripts/version-bump.mjs for 1.58.1 and verified node dist/cli/index.js version reports @slope-dev/slope v1.58.1.

shots.title: Isolate guard tests from parent repo branch and active sprint state (#526)

hazards.description: The first full release validation exposed that in-repo temp fixtures inherited the active release branch and sprint state, causing guard tests to fail only during a live sprint.

shots.notes: Moved guard test fixtures to OS temp directories and made sprint-completion branch inference decimal-aware, then reran the focused guard suites and full validation successfully.

shots.title: Validate release readiness and publish v1.58.1 through GitHub Release
shots.notes: Validated release readiness locally with build, typecheck, full test suite, version smoke, roadmap/docs/map checks, and review findings clean. PR checks then exposed a CodeQL alert in the new staging helper before merge.

shots.title: Replace version-bump git staging shell quoting with argv execution (#528)

hazards.description: GitHub Advanced Security flagged the new version-bump staging helper because it built a shell command and escaped quotes without escaping backslashes.

shots.notes: Raised #528, replaced shell-quoted git add staging with execFileSync argv-form execution, and reran focused version tests, typecheck, and build before pushing the CI fix.

conditions.description: The release readiness gates found two SLOPE-local issues (#526 before PR creation and #528 from CodeQL after PR creation); both were fixed and folded into the release sprint.
Publishing is intentionally triggered by GitHub Release after the version bump PR passes CI and merges; no manual npm publish is expected.

training.description: Release bump commands need to stage every file updated by the underlying bump script.
training.outcome: slope version bump now stages the bundled plugin manifest alongside package.json when both are present.

training.description: Inserted decimal sprints must be first-class throughout roadmap status, branch inference, scorecards, and shipped-artifact checks.
training.outcome: Roadmap status and sprint-completion branch inference now understand S146.1-style release sprints.

training.description: Guard tests should not create fixture repositories inside the active repository when branch or sprint state affects behavior.
training.outcome: The guard suites now use OS temp fixture roots so local active sprint state cannot leak into regression tests.

training.description: Release automation should pass git path arguments by argv instead of custom shell quoting.
training.outcome: Version-bump staging now uses execFileSync with `['add', ...paths]`, eliminating the CodeQL escaping alert.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm vitest run tests/cli/version.test.ts tests/cli/roadmap.test.ts` passed: 34 tests.
`corepack pnpm build`, `corepack pnpm typecheck`, and `corepack pnpm test` passed; full suite reported 232 test files passed, 1 skipped, 3639 tests passed, and 25 skipped.
After fixing #528, `corepack pnpm vitest run tests/cli/version.test.ts`, `corepack pnpm typecheck`, and `corepack pnpm build` passed.
`node dist/cli/index.js roadmap validate`, `roadmap status`, `docs generate`, `docs check`, and `map --check` passed during release readiness validation.
`node dist/cli/index.js version` reports @slope-dev/slope v1.58.1; npm registry still reports 1.58.0 until the GitHub Release publish workflow runs after merge.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A small release round with useful pressure: the release gates did exactly what they should and flushed out two local SLOPE issues before the package left the clubhouse.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When cutting a patch release, verify the generated package and plugin versions, then let GitHub Release drive the npm publish path after CI is green.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The full suite failure was not a release bug; it was a fixture isolation issue exposed by running tests from an active decimal sprint branch.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S147 can now start from a clean roadmap and a fresh patch release instead of carrying release hygiene debt.

bunker_locations: A version bump wrapper can silently under-stage files if the script it delegates to changes additional manifests.
Roadmap current-sprint logic must prefer explicitly active inserted sprints before later planned sprint ids.
Guard regression fixtures should live outside the active repository when branch name or sprint state changes behavior.
Release automation should avoid custom shell quoting for staged paths; argv-form git execution is simpler and safer.
yardage_book_updates: src/cli/commands/version.ts now exposes shared version-bump staging paths and stages the bundled plugin manifest when it exists.
src/cli/commands/roadmap.ts now resolves current roadmap work with active inserted sprint support and decimal sprint formatting.
src/cli/guards/sprint-completion.ts now uses decimal-aware branch sprint inference.
tests/cli/guards/* guard fixture roots now use OS temp directories to avoid inheriting parent repo state.
src/cli/commands/version.ts now stages version-bump files through execFileSync argument arrays instead of shell-quoted paths.
course_management_notes: Created GitHub issue #524 for release bump staging drift.
Created GitHub issue #525 for stale roadmap current-sprint selection with inserted active sprints.
Created GitHub issue #526 for guard tests inheriting parent repo branch and active sprint state.
Created GitHub issue #528 for the CodeQL alert on shell-quoted version-bump staging.
Initial release commits included 415bc4e, 6def39b, 1128c3e, and 224df13; the CodeQL #528 fix was added after PR release validation.

The release PR should include `Closes #524`, `Closes #525`, `Closes #526`, and `Closes #528`.
After merge, create GitHub Release `v1.58.1`, watch the publish workflow, and verify npm reports @slope-dev/slope 1.58.1.
